original.statement: The ETCD provider's tls.caOptional configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.

decision.reason: [ev-ebfb740bf1f8] states the ETCD provider `tls.caOptional` option was removed in v3 and shows it set either in the static configuration file (providers.etcd.tls.caOptional, YAML/TOML) or via the CLI flag --providers.etcd.tls.caOptional; the remediation is to remove it, so only environments that set it are exposed. The proposed any[values-key providers.etcd.tls.caOptional set, cli-flag --providers.etcd.tls.caOptional set] matches those two configuration forms without broadening. Confidence is low because no config-source mapping says how the static config file is read (values-key vs a ConfigMap text-line).
